mentions.name: Haven
mentions.description: Open-source, self-hostable private social media alternative, similar to Facebook circa 2012. It functions as a private blog that speaks RSS and includes a built-in RSS aggregator, letting users run a private social-media-type space where self-hosting provides actual privacy.
mentions.problem: Privacy in a social-media-type space is only achievable through self-hosting.
mentions.source_excerpt: (open source) Self-hostable, private social media alternative (like Facebook circa 2012).  Functionally it is a private blog that speaks RSS with a built-in RSS aggregator.  Self-hosting being the only way to actually have privacy in a social-media-type space.
